# Genome-Wide Nucleosome Positioning using High-Throughput Short-Read Data (MNase-Seq)

[![R-CMD-check-bioc](https://github.com/adeschen/RJMCMCNucleosomes/actions/workflows/check-bioc.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/adeschen/RJMCMCNucleosomes/actions/workflows/check-bioc.yaml)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/adeschen/RJMCMCNucleosomes/branch/devel/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/adeschen/RJMCMCNucleosomes/tree/devel)

This package uses informative Multinomial-Dirichlet prior in a t-mixture
with reversible jump estimation of nucleosome positions for genome-wide
profiling.

This package is in R with an optimized section in C++.

## Citing

If you use this package for a publication, we would ask you to cite the
following:

> Samb R, Khadraoui K, Belleau P, et al. (2015). “Using informative
> Multinomial-Dirichlet prior in a t-mixture with reversible jump
> estimation of nucleosome positions for genome-wide profiling.”
> Statistical Applications in Genetics and Molecular Biology. Volume 14,
> Issue 6, Pages 517-532, ISSN (Online) 1544-6115, ISSN (Print)
> 2194-6302, December 2015, [doi:
> 10.1515/sagmb-2014-0098](http://doi.org/10.1515/sagmb-2014-0098)

## Research Resource Identifier (RRID)

The RRID for the **RJMCMCNucleosomes** package is **RRID:SCR_029241**.

## Bioconductor Package

[![Bioconductor
Time](http://bioconductor.org/shields/years-in-bioc/RJMCMCNucleosomes.svg)](http://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/RJMCMCNucleosomes "Bioconductor status")

*RJMCMCNucleosomes* is now an official package of
[Bioconductor](http://bioconductor.org/). The current release can be
directly downloaded from their website: [Current
release](http://bioconductor.org/packages/RJMCMCNucleosomes/)

## Notes

To use this current *RJMCMCNucleosomes* version, the use of the Rcpp
package is mandatory. This implies having GSL library installed.

# Package index

## Package

- [`RJMCMCNucleosomes-package`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/RJMCMCNucleosomes-package.md)
  [`RJMCMCNucleosomes`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/RJMCMCNucleosomes-package.md)
  : RJMCMCNucleosomes: Bayesian hierarchical model for genome-wide
  nucleosome positioning with high-throughput short-read data
  (MNase-Seq)

## Nucleosome positioning

Detect nucleosome positions on a segment or on an entire chromosome.

- [`rjmcmc()`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/rjmcmc.md)
  : Nucleosome positioning mapping on a segment

- [`rjmcmcCHR()`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/rjmcmcCHR.md)
  : Nucleosome positioning mapping on a large segment, up to a
  chromosome

- [`segmentation()`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/segmentation.md)
  :

  Split a `GRanges` containing reads in a list of smaller segments for
  the `rjmcmc` function.

## Merging and post-treatment

Merge results from segments and merge closely positioned nucleosomes.

- [`mergeRDSFiles()`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/mergeRDSFiles.md)
  : Merge nucleosome information from selected RDS files.

- [`mergeAllRDSFilesFromDirectory()`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/mergeAllRDSFilesFromDirectory.md)
  : Merge nucleosome information from all RDS files present in a same
  directory. Beware that only nucleosome information from same
  chromosome should be merged together.

- [`postTreatment()`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/postTreatment.md)
  :

  A post-treatment function to merge closely positioned nucleosomes,
  from the same chromosome, identified by the `rjmcmc` function.

## Visualization

- [`plotNucleosomes()`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/plotNucleosomes.md)
  : Generate a graph of nucleosome positions with read coverage

## Printing

- [`print(`*`<rjmcmcNucleosomes>`*`)`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/print.rjmcmcNucleosomes.md)
  : Formatted output of predicted nucleosomes
- [`print(`*`<rjmcmcNucleosomesBeforeAndAfterPostTreatment>`*`)`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/print.rjmcmcNucleosomesBeforeAndAfterPostTreatment.md)
  : Formatted output of predicted nucleosomes
- [`print(`*`<rjmcmcNucleosomesMerge>`*`)`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/print.rjmcmcNucleosomesMerge.md)
  : Formatted output of predicted nucleosomes

## Datasets

- [`reads_demo_01`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/reads_demo_01.md)
  :

  Forward reads and reverse reads in `GRanges` format (for demo
  purpose).

- [`reads_demo_02`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/reads_demo_02.md)
  :

  Forward reads and reverse reads in `GRanges` format (for demo
  purpose).

- [`RJMCMC_result`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/RJMCMC_result.md)
  : Nucleosomes detected by running RJMCMC function using reads from
  reads_demo_02 dataset (for demo purpose).

- [`syntheticNucleosomeReads`](https://adeschen.github.io/RJMCMCNucleosomes/reference/syntheticNucleosomeReads.md)
  :

  Simulated dataset of reads generated by `nucleoSim` package (for demo
  purpose).
